reviews.text:
I heard about this center and wanted to know the price for lessons.
My bulldog barks at other dogs.
According to the report, the dogs fight and hurt each other badly, Stefano does not say anything to the owners and does not provide assistance.

My Marley has been going to Stefano for 6 years now; Despicable Me, it's not a center but THE CENTER, it's a paradise for our friends, large spaces to run and play, the only place where I leave my dog ​​even when I go on vacation and can't take him with me! Stefano is a very knowledgeable person, he has a wonderful love for dogs, and he is always surrounded by equally knowledgeable collaborators who do their work with passion. I highly recommend him ❤️

Geordie, our four-legged friend, grew up at the center, spending entire days there for nine years. When he was initially with us, Stefano Romano taught us lessons with him, both on and off leash. At the center, Geordie developed skills both on and around other dogs, quickly achieving exceptional balance, and today he easily manages to be a happy dog. Now, due to his ailments, he doesn't come to the center as often, but when he does go, he's happy and returns home happy. Stefano's skills and experience make him the dog whisperer.
